The focus is on three boxes of the Johnnie Walker Blue Label Xordinaire, which are prominently displayed in the foreground. These boxes are dark blue with intricate blue and gold designs, and they feature the iconic Johnnie Walker logo and the phrase "Exclusive Travel Edition."
